page.overview:
Who is Chin Chin?

Chin Chin is a non-canon character that made his only appearance in the Mortal Kombat novel.

He is a shepherd boy in the modern-day era who lives in the same village as Liu Kang and Kung Lao.

Chin Chin was the first to welcome Kano to his village, who then promptly held the young man hostage and forced him to accompany him on his mission to find a mysterious object under the orders of Shang Tsung.
